annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅 (General Office of the National Health Commission)
key_provisions_or_claims: Revises the 2015 edition of citizen health literacy basic knowledge and skills
Sets 66 items across basic concepts, healthy lifestyles and behaviors, and basic skills
Directs provincial health commissions to promote and popularize it
Covers infectious disease, chronic disease, mental health, first aid and disaster response
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's National Health Commission General Office issuing the 2024 edition of the Chinese Citizens' Health Literacy: Basic Knowledge and Skills, a 66-item public health education guide. It has no AI or robotics content. The notice asks health authorities to promote it.
annotation.title_clean: 国家卫生健康委办公厅关于印发中国公民健康素养——基本知识与技能（2024年版）的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the National Health Commission on Issuing the Chinese Citizens' Health Literacy – Basic Knowledge and Skills (2024 Edition)
